pages.title: Natural Resources
pages.description: Ars Delight adds  several ingredients  player can collect  with tools:   - Archwood Barks   - Wilden Meat   - Chimera Meat   - Chimera Horn

pages.title: Blazing Bark
pages.description: Player can gather  archwood barks by  cutting archwood  logs with axe on  cutting table.   Archwood barks is  widely used in  cooking to boost  effect of pods from  the same archwood  tree or convert  effect of pods from a  different archwood

pages.title: Wilden Meat
pages.description: Player can gather  Wilden Meat by  killing Wilden  Hunter with a knife.   It's fairly  nutritious and is  the early game  source of wilden  effect.

pages.title: Chimera Meat
pages.description: Player can gather  Chimera Meat in bulk  by killing Chimera  with a knife.   It's very nutritious  and gives strong  wilden effect when  cooked properly.

pages.title: Chimera Horn
pages.description: Player can gather  Chimera Horn by  killing Chimera with  an axe.   It's a reusable food  container and can  boost food effect.
